bullets.text: Slower Apple Features Ahead - **Apple** warns UK users of potential delays in feature rollouts due to new regulations.
4Chan and Kiwi Farms Sue UK - Controversial sites challenge the **UK's Online Safety Act**, claiming it infringes on their rights.
Apple's Antitrust Troubles Expand - **Colombia** joins global probes into **Apple's** App Store practices amid antitrust concerns.
London's Public Transit Etiquette - **Transport for London** urges commuters to wear headphones to reduce noise pollution.
WhatsApp's AI Message Feature - **WhatsApp** introduces an AI tool to help users rephrase and adjust message tones.
Pixel 10 Pro's AI Focus - **Google's** Pixel 10 Pro emphasizes AI integration in its latest smartphone iteration.
Apple's Legal Battles Continue - **Apple** fights a UK ruling over 4G patents, facing potential global implications.
New iPhone 17 Features Leaked - Anticipation builds for **Apple's** iPhone 17 Pro with rumored design and performance upgrades.
AI in 911 Centers - Understaffed 911 centers turn to AI solutions to manage non-emergency calls effectively.
Nvidia's Record Sales - **Nvidia** reports significant revenue growth, driven by demand for AI technology.
